title: Config Asset Export v1
description: Machine-readable contract for Config Asset Center bulk export (docs/architecture/config-asset-center.md §8). Replaces seed scripts: assets are identified by {asset_type, namespace, natural_key}, ordered by topology_order, and imported through Service Layer APIs (not direct INSERT). Import operations MUST be recorded in the unified audit trail (ConfigBundle audit for ConfigBundle-governed assets; native lifecycle audit for Persona, CaseItem, etc.). Export operations MAY omit audit entries but SHOULD include export_meta.exported_by when an operator triggers export. Import API options (not part of export payload): dry_run (bool), conflict_strategy (skip | fail | new_version | replace_draft; default new_version), publish_after_import (bool; ConfigBundle-governed assets use ConfigBundle lifecycle publish; native-lifecycle assets use respective Service publish/archive).

export_meta.description: Export envelope metadata. version MUST be config-asset-export-v1 for this schema.

version.description: Export protocol version. Importers reject unknown versions.

exported_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the export was generated.

source_instance.description: Optional source environment label (e.g. dev-env-1, staging).

exported_by.description: Optional operator user UUID. Recommended when export is operator-triggered.

export_audit_recorded.description: Optional. True if export was written to audit log. Import MUST record audit; export audit is optional per §8.1.

notes.description: Optional human-readable export notes (scenario name, ticket, etc.).

assets.description: Ordered bag of exported assets. Each entry is self-contained payload plus cross-instance identity (natural_key). Instance UUIDs MUST NOT appear as primary keys; importers remap IDs.

topology_order.description: Topological import order: dependencies before dependents. Each item is asset_type:natural_key (namespace defaults to default unless asset entry specifies another namespace). Importers MUST process assets in this order after validating depends_on is satisfied.

import_options_documentation.description: Optional documentation-only block for import API consumers. Not validated on export; mirrors POST /api/v1/admin/import options.

dry_run.description: When true, validate and plan import without writes.

conflict_strategy.description: skip: existing natural_key → skip. fail: existing → abort import. new_version (default): existing → create new draft only. replace_draft: overwrite draft if present; if only published exists → new_version.

publish_after_import.description: When true, publish imported assets after successful import. ConfigBundle-governed (e.g. situation_pack) via ConfigBundle lifecycle; native lifecycle assets via respective Service publish.

asset_type.description: Asset discriminator. natural_key source: persona/case_item/practice_template/agent/training_task/knowledge_base/learning_content/question_category/examiner_agent → slug of name; situation_pack → code; scoring_ruleset → version string; role_profile → slug of name or stable hash key.

namespace.description: Tenant or pack namespace. Default default when omitted on depends_on.

natural_key.description: Cross-instance stable key. Rules: persona → slug(name); situation_pack → code; case_item → slug(name); practice_template → slug(name); knowledge_base → slug(name); scoring_ruleset → version; role_profile → slug(name) or content hash key. MUST be unique per (asset_type, namespace).

content_hash.description: SHA256 digest of canonical serialized asset content for drift detection.

asset_version.description: Asset version at export: integer for ORM version counters; string for ruleset/situation_pack codes (e.g. v1, presales-cio-first-visit-v1).

name.description: Human-readable display name (source for slug natural_key on name-based assets).

payload.description: Full domain payload for import_one(). Shape is asset-type-specific; importer validates via Service Layer.

depends_on.description: Explicit dependencies declared at export time. MUST be satisfied before importing this asset. Importer also uses topology_order.

governance.description: Import write path: config_bundle → ConfigBundle lifecycle (drafts/validate/publish); native_lifecycle → asset Service draft/publish APIs.
